status: exploratory follow-up motivated by v03 failures; frozen before execution; independent seeds and new width, not an independent replication study

H44.concept: Context-conditioned complementary probe contract: choose calibration from the independently approved raw variant and backend epoch; joint noisy-reference detector; drift requires quarantine/recalibration, not a malicious label.
H44.criterion: For EACH noise and EACH approved variant: clean Wilson95 FPR upper<=0.10 AND every strong mutation Wilson95 TPR lower>=0.90. Weak rotation, drift, adaptive fabrication separately reported. No claim of protection against arbitrary provider or host.
H44.ablation: Factorial ideal/trusted-noisy references x alpha 0.05/0.01 on identical calibration/evaluation counts. Report overhead for noisy reference collection; no universal gain assumed.
H44.security_constraint: References and variant approval must precede provider execution; learning from attacker-controlled calibration invalidates the guarantee. Variant selection does not use the hidden attack label.

statistics: Wilson95 per condition, exact McNemar and Holm across candidate-versus-three-ablation comparisons on strong and weak attacks. No retuning or optional stopping.
cost: Equal evaluation shots for all four ablations; shared samples. Additional trusted reference and 511 calibration batches explicitly charged. Different calibration budget from v03 precludes attributing cross-study improvements solely to noisy reference.
interpretation: A local empirical research concept composed of established techniques; novelty not proven. Preserve all negative and adversarial outcomes.
